task: Approve an expense report only if the line items sum to the total, the per-person amount is within the policy limit, and the policy allows the category. Code does the arithmetic and the numeric comparison and passes each result as a named boolean.
code_rule: line_items_sum_matches_total and within_per_person_limit are computed in code before the call. The model only judges the policy fit and reads the precomputed flags.

state.policy: Meals with clients are reimbursable up to $75 per person. Alcohol is not reimbursable. Reports whose line items do not add up to the stated total are rejected.

report.description: Client dinner for 2 at Marea, two entrees and one bottle of wine

criteria.true: The expense is a reimbursable category, includes nothing the policy excludes, and both `report.line_items_sum_matches_total` and `report.within_per_person_limit` are true.
criteria.false: Any condition in the true criterion fails.
